item.office.grimoire.tip_unbound: Right-click to open and choose your element.
item.office.grimoire.tip_cast: Off hand + empty main hand: tap right-click to cast, hold to charge. Shift+scroll or hold R: pick spell.
item.office.rebinding_seal.tip: Right-click while bound to choose your element again. Used up only when you pick one; your level stays.
spell.office.fire_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of flame that sets targets alight.
spell.office.fire_wall.desc: Raise a curtain of fire that burns whatever crosses it.
spell.office.flame_dash.desc: Burst forward on a trail of fire.
spell.office.fireball_barrage.desc: Rain fireballs on the spot you point at.
spell.office.meteor.desc: Call a burning rock from the sky — it leaves a crater.
spell.office.water_bullet.desc: A hard jet of water that knocks foes back.
spell.office.tidal_push.desc: A wave that shoves everything in front of you.
spell.office.bubble_shield.desc: A bubble that stops arrows and softens blows.
spell.office.water_prison.desc: Trap a foe in a sphere of water.
spell.office.water_dragon.desc: A dragon of water that crashes down and floods the land.
spell.office.gust.desc: A blast of wind that throws foes back.
spell.office.blade_wind.desc: Crescent blades that cut foes and foliage.
spell.office.air_step.desc: Leap off the air itself — even mid-jump.
spell.office.tornado.desc: A whirlwind that wanders forward, lifting everything.
spell.office.wind_sphere.desc: A spinning sphere that drills through anything you hit.
spell.office.spark.desc: A quick zap that arcs to a second foe.
spell.office.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning that leaps from foe to foe.
spell.office.chidori_strike.desc: Charge through your target, carving a scorched trench.
spell.office.earth_wall.desc: Raise a wall of earth for half a minute.
spell.office.earth_spikes.desc: Spikes burst from the ground in a line.
spell.office.quake.desc: A shockwave that ripples out through the ground.
spell.office.mountain_fist.desc: A giant fist of rock erupts and leaves a mountain spire.
spell.office.shadow_bolt.desc: A bolt of shadow that saps strength.
spell.office.gravity_well.desc: A dark point that drags everything in.
spell.office.shadow_step.desc: Step out of the shadows behind your target.
spell.office.shadow_bind.desc: Shadows root a foe in place.
spell.office.black_hole.desc: A black hole that devours the land around it.
spell.office.recall.desc: Shift + cast to mark home. Cast to return there.
magic.office.choose_hint: Hover a sigil to read its page. Click it to bind.
magic.office.bind_note: This is permanent (a Rebinding Seal can change it).
magic.office.bind_failed: The binding did not take. Try again.
magic.office.hint: Off hand + empty hand: tap right-click to cast · hold to charge · R wheel · Shift+scroll
magic.office.signs_hint: Arrow keys or WASD · Esc gives up
magic.office.fizzle: The signs broke — the spell fizzled
magic.office.no_home: No home yet — Shift + cast Recall to mark one
magic.office.home_claimed: You can't mark your home inside someone else's claim
magic.office.home_blocked: Your home is blocked or unsafe — you stay where you are
magic.office.busy: Too much magic here — wait a moment
magic.office.wrong_element: %s belongs to another element — you are bound to %s
magic.office.step_unsafe: No safe ground there — the shadows hold you back
magic.office.undo_done: Restored %d blocks from %d casts; %d left alone (changed since the cast)
magic.office.undo_help: Undo a player's last n terrain casts (the newest 20 are kept). Blocks changed since the cast are left alone
magic.office.travel_cooldown: Travel shares Recall's cooldown — ready in %s s
magic.office.travel_pending: You already asked %s — wait for an answer
magic.office.travel_too_soon: Give %s a moment — you can ask again in %s s
magic.office.travel_friend_full: %s has too many requests waiting — try again soon
magic.office.travel_accept_hover: %s appears beside you after a 3 s channel
magic.office.travel_deny_hover: Say no — they stay where they are
magic.office.travel_gone: That travel request is no longer open
magic.office.travel_blocked: No safe spot beside %s — you stay where you are
magic.office.travel_now_on: Friends can ask to travel to you again (/magic travel off to refuse)
magic.office.travel_now_off: You refuse travel requests now (/magic travel on to allow them)
magic.office.travel_state_on: You accept travel requests (/magic travel off to refuse)
magic.office.travel_state_off: You refuse travel requests (/magic travel on to allow them)
magic.office.howto_cast: Grimoire in your OFF hand, main hand empty. Tap right-click: quick cast. Hold it and the circle grows; release for a stronger cast. Shift + scroll or hold R (wheel) picks spells. Holding the Grimoire shows mana on the XP bar.
magic.office.howto_signs: The ultimate asks for hand signs: press the arrows shown before time runs out.
magic.office.hold_hint: Put the Grimoire in your off hand (%s) with an empty main hand to cast.
magic.office.friends_none: Nobody else is online right now
magic.office.travel_blurb: Once they accept, you appear beside them.
magic.office.friends_hint: Click a friend to ask · they accept, 3 s later you're there · shares Recall's cooldown
magic.office.tree_hint: Arrows move · Enter ranks up · ranks cost XP levels and your element's materials
tree.office.repick_warn: Ranks are kept. Uses 1 Rebinding Seal: then every fork may change for 60 s. Materials are not refunded.
tree.office.repick_free: Re-picks are free for %s s more. Materials are not refunded.
tree.office.coach: Click a glowing node, then press Rank up
fork.office.fire_bolt.scatter.desc: Three bolts in a fan, each weaker
fork.office.fire_bolt.searing.desc: Burns twice as long, +50 % on burning
fork.office.fire_bolt.flare.desc: Bursts on impact, setting all alight
fork.office.fire_wall.marching.desc: Rolls 6 blocks forward as it burns
fork.office.fire_wall.backdraft.desc: Dies in a blast of fire
fork.office.flame_dash.comet.desc: The dash ends in a blast
fork.office.flame_dash.wake.desc: Burnt foes slowed and burn longer
fork.office.fireball_barrage.napalm.desc: Burns three times as long, slows
fork.office.fireball_barrage.rapid.desc: Twice as fast, two more fireballs
fork.office.fireball_barrage.heavy.desc: Bigger blasts and craters, one fewer
fork.office.tidal_push.breaker.desc: The wave hits all it carries
fork.office.bubble_shield.mirror.desc: Sends arrows back at the shooter
fork.office.water_prison.crushing.desc: The prisoner is hurt every second
fork.office.water_prison.twin.desc: A second sphere takes another foe
fork.office.water_prison.whirlpool.desc: Drags others in and slows them
fork.office.water_dragon.torrent.desc: A wider strike, knocks back harder
fork.office.blade_wind.tempest.desc: What they hit is thrown up
fork.office.air_step.long_jump.desc: Leaps more than twice as far
fork.office.tornado.eye.desc: Wider, pulls in twice as hard
fork.office.wind_sphere.vortex.desc: Leaves a vortex pulling foes in
fork.office.wind_sphere.shuriken.desc: Twice the blast, throws foes up
fork.office.wind_sphere.shockwave.desc: A ring of wind sweeps out to 12
fork.office.spark.static.desc: Marks and slows what it strikes
fork.office.spark.overcharge.desc: Arcs hit in full and leap farther
fork.office.chain_lightning.conductor.de: Barely fades from hop to hop
fork.office.chain_lightning.thunderstorm: A sky bolt on every target
fork.office.blink.static_step.desc: Shocks foes where you leave and land
fork.office.blink.quick.desc: Ready again in half the time
fork.office.blink.thunderclap.desc: Landing stuns and throws foes back
fork.office.blink.surge.desc: Speed II and Haste II for 5 s
fork.office.thunder_spear.storm.desc: Three sky bolts round the impact
fork.office.thunder_spear.chain.desc: Arcs on to three more creatures
fork.office.chidori_strike.kirin.desc: Five sky bolts round the end
fork.office.stone_bullet.boulder.desc: A much bigger stone, more knockback
fork.office.stone_bullet.ricochet.desc: Bounces on to the next creature
fork.office.stone_bullet.concussion.desc: Blinds and slows what it hits
fork.office.earth_wall.thorns.desc: Hurts and pushes off what touches it
fork.office.earth_wall.bastion.desc: Shields and heals you beside it
fork.office.earth_spikes.impale.desc: Twice the damage, a shorter line
fork.office.earth_spikes.petrify.desc: Roots and weakens what it hits
fork.office.quake.aftershock.desc: A second ring a second later
fork.office.quake.tectonic.desc: Throws twice as high and far
fork.office.shadow_bolt.twin.desc: Two bolts, each a little weaker
fork.office.gravity_well.repulsor.desc: Flings everything out at the end
fork.office.shadow_step.backstab.desc: Strikes the target as you appear
fork.office.shadow_step.swap.desc: You trade places with the target
fork.office.shadow_step.phantom.desc: Speed II and Strength I for 5 s
fork.office.shadow_bind.choking.desc: Rooted foes are hurt every second
fork.office.shadow_bind.dread.desc: Blinds and weakens as it lets go
fork.office.black_hole.supernova.desc: A collapse twice as wide and hard
fork.office.black_hole.dark_rain.desc: Fires eight shadow bolts as it dies
tree.office.tip_ready: Ready: select it, then Rank up
